messages:
Meera (CSM): Heads-up — LightWave dropped active seats from ~64% to ~8% after their ML lead rotated in and paused several pipelines. Raising renewal risk triage.
alerts-bot: alert account=lightwave metric=active_seats drop=56pct window=4d severity=high
Diego (AM): Any cause notes? cost, latency, or did they flip model families?
Meera (CSM): Procurement flagged a cost-savings review; engineering mentions a short competitor pilot and an SSO token refresh causing repeated reconnects.
Zara (Solutions): Can you paste a sample error? If it's session/SSO we can tune keepalive and reduce reconnections quickly.
Meera (CSM): Snippet: "WARN auth: token_refresh rate_limit exceeded -> session reset" from their staging. Also p50 latency jumped from 95ms to 260ms after the change.
Hana (Sales): If competitor is a cost play, propose a scoped 4-week Dedicated trial + a fixed-price SLA. I'll draft procurement collateral.
Diego (AM): Action items: 1) Zara to test keepalive/token backoff tweak (8-12h) 2) Hana to draft price-lock one-pager for procurement 3) Meera to message new ML lead (cc @kai_lightwave) with a short offer + request for their pilot goals. Check-in 48h. I'll own timeline.
Zara (Solutions): I'll run a minimal repro and share a short config diff they can apply to staging. ETA 10h. If it helps, we ask them to validate before next week.
Meera (CSM): Sent quick ask: "Kai — is the pilot primarily focused on lowering cost or reducing latency? We can run a 4-week Dedicated proof with fixed throughput and a short tuning session." Waiting. :pray:
alerts-bot: note historical p50 latency=95ms current p50=260ms after drop
Meera (CSM): Update 2h later — Kai replied: "Mainly cost, but also jitter. Open to trial if you can show predictable monthly spend and lower p50." Moving to pilot prep.
Hana (Sales): I'll coordinate with pricing ops on a conditional price-lock and a simple SLA for p50/jitter to present to procurement.
Diego (AM): Good. Keep this thread for patch results and procurement docs; if we get a positive pilot sign-off we'll tie it into the renewal playbook.
